benefits.name: Annual Free Night Award
benefits.description: One Free Night Award every year after card renewal month, redeemable at a Marriott Bonvoy hotel with a redemption level at or under 35,000 points, plus an additional Free Night Award after $60,000 in eligible purchases in a calendar year.
benefits.terms: Base award is automatic each card renewal year. A second Free Night Award (same 35,000-point redemption cap) is earned after $60,000 in eligible purchases within a calendar year.

benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite status, plus 15 Elite Night Credits toward the next elite tier each calendar year.
benefits.terms: Automatic with cardmembership; requires a linked Marriott Bonvoy account. 15 Elite Night Credits awarded each calendar year.

benefits.name: Amex Biz Card Member Rate Discount
benefits.description: 7% discount on standard room rates at hotels participating in Marriott Bonvoy when booked directly through the Amex Biz Card Member Rate on Marriott's site.
benefits.terms: Applies only to bookings made through the designated Amex Biz Card Member Rate channel on Marriott's booking site.

earningRates.terms: Base card rate at hotels participating in Marriott Bonvoy.
Restaurants worldwide, U.S. gas stations, wireless telephone services purchased directly from U.S. service providers, and U.S. purchases for shipping.
